functions.name: import-meeting
functions.description: Import an existing meeting from an external source, optionally including a transcript and requesting processing.

title.description: Meeting title as ordinary Unicode text.

endTime.description: End instant with explicit UTC marker or offset; must not precede startTime.

attendees.description: Optional attendees; omission leaves attendance unspecified and an empty array supplies no attendees.

isInternal.description: Whether the attendee belongs to the organization, if known.

items.description: An attendee of the imported meeting.

startTime.description: Start instant with an explicit UTC marker or offset.

transcript.description: Optional transcript; omitted when not supplied.

text.description: Spoken Unicode text, including empty source text.

timestampSeconds.description: Segment position in seconds, provisionally relative to recording start; fractional precision is subject to validation.

items.description: A transcript segment in source order.

segments.description: Transcript segments in source order; an empty array remains empty.

recordingUrl.description: Optional URL of the existing recording.

externalMeetingId.description: Optional source-system meeting ID; not a documented deduplication key.

processImportedMeeting.description: Explicitly choose whether Momentum should process the imported meeting.

FunctionInput_momentum_io_importmeeting.description: An existing meeting to import, with optional recording, attendance, transcript and Salesforce associations.

received.description: Momentum returned success for receipt of this import; not proof of completed processing or deduplication.

FunctionOutput_momentum_io_importmeeting.description: Immediate acknowledgement of the meeting import, without waiting for processing.

tags.instructions: Use this to bring an existing meeting into Momentum; use `remap-meeting` to change existing Salesforce associations. Provide the host, title and times and explicitly choose whether to process the meeting. Success confirms receipt, not completed processing. The serialized request must fit within 5 MB. Do not blindly retry an uncertain result: deduplication is not documented. Meetings without recordings may not appear in `list-meetings`.

functions.name: list-meetings
functions.description: List one page of external, non-cancelled meetings with recorded calls in a time window, including available transcripts and optional temporary download links.

to.description: Inclusive upper window bound; defaults to initial-call current time and must not precede from. Applies to endTime for contained, startTime for start.

from.description: Inclusive lower bound on startTime, with explicit UTC marker or offset.

limit.description: Maximum meetings in one page; keep unchanged on continuation.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation for the same filters and limit; omitted initially.

sourceTypes.description: Source systems to include; omission includes all types.

items.description: Recorded-call source system.

windowMatch.description: contained requires startTime >= from and endTime <= to; start requires from <= startTime <= to.

attendeeEmails.description: Require all listed attendees; omitted or empty applies no attendee filter.

items.description: Attendee email address required in each matching meeting.

includeDownloadUrl.description: Request available recording URLs valid for two hours; defaults to false.

salesforceAccountId.description: Associated Salesforce account filter; cannot combine with opportunity filter.

salesforceOpportunityId.description: Associated Salesforce opportunity filter; cannot combine with account filter.

FunctionInput_momentum_io_listmeetings.description: Recorded-meeting window, filters, and one-page continuation settings.

id.description: Opaque Momentum meeting ID, when supplied.

endTime.description: End instant in UTC Z, when supplied.

attendees.description: Attendees; omission and an empty array remain distinct.

salesforceCaseId.description: Associated Salesforce case ID, if supplied.

salesforceLeadId.description: Associated Salesforce lead ID, if supplied.

items.description: Meeting attendee details.

startTime.description: Start instant in UTC Z, when supplied.

transcript.description: Available processed transcript; omitted when not supplied.

segments.description: Transcript entries in provider order; empty remains empty.

text.description: Spoken content as ordinary Unicode text.

timestampLabel.description: Original opaque provider timestamp label, not interpreted as an instant; omitted if unavailable.

timestampSeconds.description: Position in seconds, provisionally recording-relative; omitted if unavailable.

items.description: One transcript entry in provider order.

downloadUrl.description: Requested temporary recording URL, if generated; valid for two hours.

salesforceCaseId.description: Associated Salesforce case ID, if supplied.

salesforceLeadId.description: Associated Salesforce lead ID, if supplied.

salesforceAccountId.description: Associated Salesforce account ID, if supplied.

downloadUrlExpiresAt.description: Recording URL expiration instant in UTC Z, if generated.

salesforceOpportunityId.description: Associated Salesforce opportunity ID, if supplied.

items.description: An external, non-cancelled meeting with a recorded call.
One page ordered by startTime then ID ascending.

nextCursor.description: Continuation for the same query; omitted when upstream continuation is null or absent.

FunctionOutput_momentum_io_listmeetings.description: One recorded-meeting page with available transcripts and optional recording references.

tags.instructions: Use this for recorded-meeting lookup, not all scheduled or cancelled meetings. Results are ordered by startTime then ID ascending. Pass nextCursor back as cursor with unchanged filters and limit; omit cursor for a new query. limit is 1–50, default 10. Transcripts may be unavailable before processing. Requested recording links expire after two hours; request fresh ones when needed. Use `remap-meeting` to change Salesforce associations.

functions.name: remap-meeting
functions.description: Associate an existing meeting with new Salesforce records and optionally request a call summary and AI signals. Returns request acceptance rather than completed remapping.

source.description: External meeting identity instead of internal ID or explicit details.

id.description: Meeting ID in the selected external system.

type.description: System whose external meeting ID is supplied.

salesforceRecords.description: New associations; at least one ID is required. Omitted association types have provider-defined remapping semantics, not an implicit preservation or clearing guarantee.

FunctionInput_momentum_io_remapmeeting.description: Identify an existing meeting and supply new Salesforce associations and optional generation requests.

accepted.description: Whether the provider accepted this request, not whether remapping or generation finished.

requestId.description: Provider request identifier for tracking the submission.

FunctionOutput_momentum_io_remapmeeting.description: Immediate provider acceptance and the request identifier, not remapping completion.

tags.instructions: Use this to correct Salesforce associations, not to import a meeting. Identify the meeting by exactly one of internal ID, external source, or title/start/host details. `list-meetings` provides IDs and details. Supply at least one Salesforce record. Existing associations may be replaced and no undo is documented. Optional summary and signal generation have additional effects; do not blindly replay. Keep requestId for tracking; accepted does not establish completion.
